Is there any difference between Thyristor and SCR? Draw the I-V characteristrics of SCR and find out latching current, forward and reverse breakover voltage.

A load, R is in series with a thyristor and sinusoidal AC voltafe. If the positive gate pulses are at 0, 3π/4 and 5π/4, and negative gate pulse is at between 3π/4 and 5π/4, draw the output voltage and current waveforms. Also, if the thyristor is replaced by a GTO in the same circuit, what will be the new waveforms in this case? (There was a circuit, couldn't find in any book)

A 2300/230 V, 200kVA transformer has a primary resistance of 0.4ohm in HV side and secondary resistance of 3.5ohm in LV side. Determine: 
 a. Low and High Voltage side current 
 b. Equivalent resistance referred to hv side
For a single-phase no load xmer, which one of the following losses will be the minimum? - Cu Losses (MCQ)
A 10kVA, 11/0.4 kV, D-Y distribution transformer has a resistance of 114ohm and reactance of 800ohm per phase referred tp the HT side. Find the voltage regulation at 95% load with 0.85 pf lagging.

A 1000VA, 230/115 V transformer has been tested to determine its equivalent circuit. The results of the open circuit tests are: Voc=230V, Ioc=0.45A and Poc=30W. All data give were taken from the primary side of the transformer. Determine Rc and Xm.
A 100kVa, single phase transformer has an iron loss of 500@ and a copper loss of 200@ at full load current. Calculate the efficiency at 25% load and 0.8 pf lagging.

A 3-phase xmer bank is to handle 600kVA and have a 34.5/13.8 kV voltage ration. Find the rating of each individual transformer in the bank (HV, LV, Turns Ration and S) if the xmer is connected to D-Y. (MCQ)
The hysteresis and eddy current losses in a dc machine running at 1000 rpm are 250 W and 100 W respectively. If the flux remains constant, at what speed will be total iron losses be halved?
The hysteresis and eddy current losses in a dc machine running at 1000 rpm are 250 W and 100 W respectively. If the flux remains constant, at what speed will be total iron losses be halved?

A 200V dc shunt machine has an armature resistance of 0.5ohm and field resistance of 200ohm. The machine is running at 1000 rpm as a motor is drawing 31 A from the supply. Calculate the speed at which the machine must be driven by a prime mover to make this run as a generator and deliver the same line current.

A dc shunt motor is connected to 240V supply. It is running at a speed of 1500 rpm having 0.68 armature resistance and 40A armature current. Friction and windage loss is 600 W. Find the shaft torque in SI unit.
A two-pole, 50 Hz induction motor rotates at a speed of 2950 rpm. What will be the slip of the motor if the torque is doubled. - 3.33% (MCQ)

A 4-pole, 50 Hz, 3-phase induction motor has rotor resistance per phase of 0.03ohm and reactance per phase of 0.12ohm. Find the amount of external resistance per phase required to be inserted to obtain 75% maximum torque at start.

A 13.2kV, 25MVA, 0.8 pf lagging, Y-connected synchronous generator has a synchronous reactance of 2.5 ohm and an armature resistance of 0.2 ohm. What is the internal generated voltage of this machine at rated conditions?
A 3-phase 25 MVA, 13.8kV, 50Hz, Delta connected synchronous generator supplies the rated load at 0.8 pf lagging. Xa is 0.5 ohm, Ra is negligible. Find voltage regulation.
A 600kVA, delta connected has line voltage of 220 V. If it is reconnected in star, calculate the new kVA rating, voltage and current rating of the alternator.

A 3-phase alternator has generated emf per phase of 230 V with 10 per cent third harmonic and 6 percent fifth harmonic content. Calculate the rms line voltage for 
 a. star connection 
 b. delta connection 
 Find also the circulating current in delta connection if the reactance per phase of the machine at 50 Hz is 10 ohm.

An alternator is operating in parallel with another synchronous generator of same size, supplying total load of a system. The governor set points of both generators are equally decreased. The total load is kept unchanged. What will happen to the system frequency? - Decrease (MCQ).
How a synchronous machine of 400V, 60 Hz can be run at 50 Hz?
The transfer function of a system T(s) = 25/(s<sup>2</sup>+2s+25). Find the oscillation frequency and damping ratio.
The transfer function of a system T(s) = 1/(0.25s<sup>2</sup>+s+1). Find the oscillation frequency and damping ratio. Also determine the unit response of the system.
The impulse response of an LTI system is h(t) = e<sup>-t</sup>.u(t). Find the output y(t) if the input is x(t) = u(t). (MCQ)
A unity feedback system has G(s) = K(s+5)/(s+8)(s+10). What is the value of K to yield 10% error in steady state for unit step input? (MCQ)
If x(t) = 5 cos 600 πt + 10 cos 1000 πt - 100 cos 6800 πt, what is the fundamental frequency and nyquist rate of x(t)? (MCQ)
Calculate the bit rate of a single channel PCM systen that uses the standard band limited telephone channel.

An analog signal having a bandwidth of 4kHz is converted to PCM signal using sampling at a rate of 20% above the Nyquist rate. The samples are quantized into 1024 levels. Determine whether a channel of the capacity of 50 kbps is sufficient for transmitting the PCM signal or not.

A 32-channel TDMA based digital communication system uses A-law compression with 16 bit PCM. Sampling rate of the system is 8kHz abd each frame uses additional 2 bits for the purpose of error control and synchronization. What is the bit rate of the system? (MCQ)

A TDM-PCM system multiplexes 10 music signals, each band-limited to 300-500 Hz. The signals are sampled at a rate of 60% higher than the nyquist rate and encoded using an 8-bit PCM encoder. Each TDM frame includes 2 bits for synchronization and framing. Determine the number of quantization levels, frame length, and data rate of the multiplexed signal.
Im a PCM system, and 8 kHz sinusoidal signal is uniformly sampled with a rate twice the nyquist frequency. If the bit rate is 160 kbps. Determine the SNR of the system in dB. (MCQ)

In a pcm system, an 8kHz sine signal is uniformly sampled with a rate of 75% higher than the nyquist frequency. The quantizer uses a rounding operation and the maximum quantization error is 4% of the peak amplitude of the signal. Determine the bit rate and SNR of the system in dB.
The output power from an audio amplifier is 10@ when the signal frequency is 1kHz. At a signal frequency of 10 kHz, the output power is 1 W. Calculate the dB change in power. (MCQ)
A voice grade channel of telephone network has a bandwidth of 3.4kHz. Calculate the information capacity of the channel for a signal to noise ratio of 30dB.
In an amplitude modulation carrier power is 1000 W and sideband power is 180 W. Find the modulation index.
